name: sub2api-image
description: Codex-native image generation and editing through a user-configured Sub2API OpenAI-compatible Images API.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images with a private Sub2API key.
interface.longDescription: Sub2API Image lets Codex configure a local Sub2API endpoint once, then generate, edit, and batch-generate images through an OpenAI-compatible Images API without exposing the user's key in replies or logs.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image from this prompt
